description: Source code for telemetry event receiver and dispatcher, managing event queue, threading, and integration with telemetry system.

methods.name: freeT2Event
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a T2Event object.

methods.name: T2ER_PushDataWithDelim
methods.description: Processes event info string, splits into name and value, and pushes to event queue.

methods.name: T2ER_Push
methods.description: Pushes individual event name and value into the event queue.

methods.name: T2ER_EventDispatchThread
methods.description: Thread function that dispatches events from queue to profiles.

methods.name: T2ER_Init
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry event receiver, creates queue, registers callbacks.

methods.name: flushCacheFromFile
methods.description: Reads cached telemetry data from files and sends them.

methods.name: T2ER_StopDispatchThread
methods.description: Stops the dispatch thread and flushes cache.

methods.name: T2ER_Uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes the telemetry event receiver, stops thread, cleans up.
